extracted.title: Mistral 7B
extracted.problem: The problem of large language models being inefficient and having high inference latency.
extracted.approach: Mistral 7B introduces a carefully designed language model that leverages grouped-query attention (GQA) and sliding window attention (SWA) to deliver high performance while maintaining efficiency.
extracted.key_results: Mistral 7B outperforms the best open 13B model (Llama 2) across all evaluated benchmarks, and surpasses the best released 34B model (Llama 1) in reasoning, mathematics, and code generation.
extracted.novelty: Mistral 7B introduces a novel attention mechanism, sliding window attention, which allows for faster inference and reduced memory requirement, and a rolling buffer cache to limit cache size.

extracted.title: Attention Is All You Need
extracted.problem: sequence transduction models, such as machine translation, have sequential computation that limits parallelization
extracted.approach: Transformer model architecture that relies entirely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
extracted.key_results: 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task
extracted.novelty: first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequence-aligned RNNs or convolution

extracted.title: AN IMAGE IS WORTH 16X16 WORDS: TRANSFORMERS FOR IMAGE RECOGNITION AT SCALE
extracted.problem: Transformers have not been widely applied to computer vision tasks, and their applications to image recognition remain limited.
extracted.approach: Applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications, by splitting an image into patches and providing the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Transformer.
extracted.key_results: 88.55% accuracy on ImageNet, 90.72% on ImageNet-ReaL, 94.55% on CIFAR-100, and 77.63% on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
extracted.novelty: Demonstrating that large scale pre-training makes vanilla Transformers competitive with (or even better than) state-of-the-art CNNs.
